title: Alone Again (Naturally)
lyrics:
[00:11.35]In a little while from now
[00:13.87]If I'm not feeling any less sour
[00:16.57]I promise myself to treat myself and visit a nearby tower
[00:22.19]And, climbing to the top, will throw myself off
[00:27.74]In an effort to make clear to whoever what it's like when you're shattered
[00:33.30]Left standing in the lurch at a church
[00:36.79]Where people are saying "My God, that's tough! She stood him up!
[00:41.55]No point in us remaining
[00:44.50]We may as well go home" — as I did on my own
[00:49.98]Alone again, naturally
[00:55.46]To think that only yesterday
[00:58.17]I was cheerful, bright and gay
[01:00.93]Looking forward to  — well, who wouldn't do? — the role I was about to play
[01:06.43]But, as if to knock me down, reality came around
[01:11.85]And, without so much as a mere touch, cut me into little pieces
[01:17.89]Leaving me to doubt — talk about God in His mercy!
[01:23.21]Oh, if He really does exist, why did He desert me
[01:28.72]In my hour of need? I truly am indeed
[01:34.11]Alone again, naturally
[01:39.76]It seems to me that there are more hearts broken in the world
[01:44.48]That can't be mended
[01:47.28]Left unattended
[01:50.11]What do we do?
[01:52.90]What do we do?
[02:35.79]Alone again, naturally
[02:41.60]Now looking back over the years
[02:44.11]And whatever else that appears
[02:47.07]I remember I cried when my father died
[02:49.77]Never wishing to hide the tears
[02:52.59]And at sixty-five years old
[02:55.37]My mother — God rest her soul —
[02:58.20]Couldn't understand why the only man
[03:00.86]She had ever loved had been taken
[03:03.76]Leaving her to start with a heart so badly broken
[03:09.31]Despite encouragement from me
[03:11.97]No words were ever spoken
[03:14.83]And when she passed away, I cried and cried all day
[03:20.23]Alone again, naturally
[03:25.91]Alone again, naturally
